versions.content: If cascaded action lists are used (i.e. using references to other rules or action lists) the action list structure may contain up to seven (7) hierarchic levels. Note: The purpose of this limit is to make testing of BswM implementations and genera- tor tools possible. The limit must be checked by the generator tool.
